evidence: Clear directory-based modularity with domain-aligned subdirectories under 'control/' (e.g., airquality, bot, weather) and 'tests/'
Shared core utilities in 'utils/' (config, db_helper, data_collection) used across modules, indicating tight integration
Single entry point (main.py) orchestrating background scheduler and message handlers, with no inter-process communication
Low average fan-out (1.15) and shallow directory depth (4) suggest cohesive, non-distributed modules
All modules import from the same package ('everyday_wechat') with no external service boundaries
Shared database via db_helper and config, indicating a single data store
Use of itchat for monolithic bot logic without decoupled service boundaries
risks: Tight coupling between modules (e.g., data_collection imports multiple control modules directly)
Potential for module boundary violations due to shared state in config and db_helper
Limited scalability due to single-process architecture
